Privacy Policy

Last updated: 19 October 2026

Who we are

This site processes Furtuna Skin creator partnership applications on behalf of Furtuna Skin. Questions about this policy: contact us.

What we collect

  • Contact details you provide (name, email, phone, address).
  • Social media profile links and audience information.
  • Product photos and product details you upload.
  • Technical logs (IP address, user agent) for security and rate limiting.
  • Your explicit consent to the Terms & Conditions, including the version and timestamp.

Why we process it

  • To evaluate and respond to your partnership application.
  • To contact you about collaborations you may qualify for.
  • To meet legal obligations, including recording your consent.
  • To prevent abuse (spam, flooding, automated submissions).

Legal bases

  • Steps taken at your request prior to entering a contract.
  • Legitimate interests in running and securing the program.
  • Consent, where required (for example, accepting the Terms).

Sharing

We use managed infrastructure providers (Supabase for data and file storage, Vercel for hosting and serverless functions). We do not sell your data. Application access is restricted to authorized partnership staff.

Retention

Applications are retained while under review and for a reasonable period afterwards for follow-up and record-keeping. Uploaded files are stored in private storage and can be deleted on request or when an application is withdrawn.

Your rights

Depending on your location, you may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data, object to processing, or request a copy in a portable format. Contact us using the link above and we will respond within the legally required timeframe.

Security

Data is transmitted over TLS. Storage buckets are private; files are served only through authenticated, time-limited links for authorized staff or via the public Terms endpoint. Database access from this site is protected with row-level security.

Changes

We will update this page when our practices change and revise the date above.
